name: custom-command
help: Configure the FortiGate switch controller to send custom commands to managed FortiSwitch devices.

command-name.name: command-name
command-name.help: Command name called by the FortiGate switch controller in the execute command.

command.name: command
command.help: String of commands to send to FortiSwitch devices (For example (%0a = return key): config switch trunk %0a edit myTrunk %0a set members port1 port2 %0a end %0a).
